status: Accepted OMF Duration count/rate/interpretation/audio-display/DF/retention rules. Frame Rate and remaining OMF fields under review.

authorization.statement: OK, let's lock those Duration rules in for Bella. Next, how do Media Composer, MDVX and MediaMuster read Frame Rate from OMF, and what should Bella read and keep?
authorization.scope: Accepts preceding OMF Duration proposal including safely owned typed Length/SampleRate, bounded same-owner summary frequency recovery with Length unchanged, shared exact interpreter/formatter, own audio display clock, qualified DF, zero/blank/long-duration behavior and compact retention. Starts Frame Rate research. No runtime implementation/cutover, Bin Filter change, new header-opening trigger or final cross-source priority table.

agreedBellaRules.scope: OMF Duration contribution in an already-read supported header. Kind accepted; no runtime implementation/cutover, Bin Filter change, final priority table, new Duration-only header open or routine database/header comparison.
agreedBellaRules.ownerAndCount: Qualified full-ID physical file owner, safely resolved own supported descriptor, exact typed Length and SampleRate. Nonnegative count and positive rate; no clip/master/source GroupLength or other-source count/clock substitution. Preserve independently valid data and inventory on field failure.
agreedBellaRules.wireAndValues: Known legacy Long signed32 Length and ExactEditRate two signed32 words/eight bytes in established numeric order. Preserve Avid field names and valid original source words. Internal64 count is not extended64 wire approval. Unsupported/damaged/negative/sentinel/ambiguous required timing is unavailable, not zero.
agreedBellaRules.interpretation: Share approved pure source-qualified AvidDurationInterpreter: exact23.976*k ->24000*k/1001 and29.97*k->30000*k/1001, k1..10, including exact equivalent fractions. Apply to known video ExactEditRate and qualified audio display EditRate; not audio frequency or arbitrary Rational; no approximate snapping. Semantic conversion precedes exact common arithmetic.
agreedBellaRules.boundedAudioRateRecovery: Usable ownMDFL pair first. When MDFL rate is unusable, permit valid unambiguous already-decoded same-owned supported WAVD:Summary.fmt /AIFD:Summary.COMM frequency, including accepted contextual WAVE descriptor compatibility. Retain raw rate availability and compact selected recovery origin/status. Never substitute summary frame count or outer native chunk count for OMF Length or conceal contradictory required timing. Audio summary/native decoder details continue in subsequent field review.
agreedBellaRules.audioDisplayClock: Same qualified file mob own typed CPNT:EditRate only; interpreted exact display clock is separate from audio frequency and does not fill audio Frame Rate column. Missing/damaged/ambiguous positive-audio display clock leaves label blank while exact sample duration survives. No master/project/other-source clock guess.
agreedBellaRules.mathsAndDisplay: Share DurationFormatter and verified checked integer/fraction maths. Video physical frames at interpreted clock; audio exact sample duration converts to display frames with a single final nearest/positive-half-up rounding. Nominal base only for numbering. Retain samples, show genuine0 and valid rounded0, permit hours>24, no StartTC/inclusive-end addition. Existing established-zero exception and mode separators apply.
agreedBellaRules.numbering: Qualified applicable file/source full ID, essence track/kind, mapped position/span, compatible exact clock and nominal FPS. Legacy Flags full numeric32 word bit0. Agreed simple direct/immediate-source scope; DF initially30000/1001/base30 or60000/1001/base60. Complete proven absence=>NDF; damaged/broken/ambiguous/mixed/unsupported applicable mode=>blank label. NDF-only clock needs no unrelated flag walk. DFHH;MM;SS;FF, NDFHH:MM:SS:FF.
agreedBellaRules.retention: Compact exact count/rate/source context, necessary own audio display clock and numbering/availability state. Keep no permanent raw object graph, summary copy or formatted label solely for Duration. Scoped temporary lifetimes, QtEndian and C++17 fixed-width values with checked/wide or factor-cancelled integer operations.
agreedBellaRules.nativeDifference: Do not automatically copy native AIFD/WAVD summary frequency overrides or zero-Length summary count fill. Bella deliberately preserves selected OMF Length and genuine-zero principle. Native metadata reader behavior does not establish universal GUI Duration behavior.
agreedBellaRules.sourceBoundary: Preserve agreed MDB-first principle. This OMF field review defines no new header-open trigger or final cross-source eligibility/priority and introduces no hybrid timing.
